about_the_game:
You enter an elevator.
A cold voice speaks:

“There are 8 floors.
On each floor, you will answer one question.”

Two buttons appear — YES or NO.
One is right. One is wrong.
Choose carefully.

Each mistake sends you down.
Each correct answer takes you higher.
But the higher you go,
the questions start to feel different.
The silence between each floor grows longer.
And you start to realize —
something is waiting at the top.

GAME FEATURES

  • 8 unique floors, each with psychological challenges

  • Tension-based sound and light reactions

  • Atmospheric and minimalist horror design

  • Multiple endings depending on your accuracy

  • Short but intense story-driven experience

A short psychological horror about choices, fear, and what happens when you reach the final floor.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features mild psychological horror and a dark atmosphere.
It includes tense moments and eerie sounds, but contains no violence, gore, or sexual content.
